title: Zone
description: Which side band beside the catch playfield holds the trace. auto = left (the right band carries the input overlay on many skins). The cluster hugs the playfield edge with its ruler level with the catcher.

title: Nudge x / px
description: Moves the cluster horizontally from its zone position (1080p pixels).

title: Nudge y / px
description: Moves the cluster vertically; negative is up.

title: Scale
description: Size multiplier, 0.5–2. Grows away from the playfield.

title: Window / seconds
description: How much gameplay time the trace shows, newest at the ruler. Clamped to 2–30 s.

title: Orientation
description: vertical: the ruler runs left to right like the playfield and older movement rises away from it. horizontal: a shorter block, newest movement at the right, playfield 0 at the top.

title: Show stats
description: Dash share of active play time (breaks excluded), distance travelled in screens (one screen = the 512 px playfield width) and direction changes per minute.

title: Hold on results
description: Keep the final trace and stats on the results screen; osu! does not show movement stats there. Turn off if it covers your results layout.

title: Backing
description: none: marks float on the game with a text shadow. scrim: a soft dark fade behind the cluster. panel: a graphite 18-LAB panel.

title: Accent
description: Colour of the dash marks and live markers. map: a tone taken from the current map's background; falls back to 18-LAB amber when the map has none.
